Novex Raoh Yuzu Shio Ramen has been developed through a state-of-the-art process without frying the noodles and then pairing them with a rich and savory umami broth. The Novex Raoh series combines the best non-fried noodles with the best broths, so each variety provides a different taste and texture from the last. This Yuzu Shio variety uses a medium-thick straight noodle, which is slightly snappier and crispier than some other varieties in the series. The noodles have been paired with a tasty lightly-salted broth which blends the delightful flavor of chicken and kelp, with the sharp and refreshing flavor of yuzu. The noodles contain whole wheat flour which is more nutritious and has more fiber than regular wheat, so you can feel good about indulging in a quick and easy light meal. Instructions Bring 450ml of water to a boil, then add noodles and boil them for 4 minutes. In the meanwhile, add the soup base that come in a separate bag into a bowl.
